title: Titanium Ball Valve Stem
system: Chemical Pipe Fittings & Flow Control Components
function: Ball valve stem (Grade 5) for chemical valve
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Ball Valve Stem where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Ball valve stem (Grade 5) for chemical valve requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by ball valve stem (grade 5) for chemical valve and service environment demands.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for valve component geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with Class 6g gauge
TIG welding Grade 2 with Class 6g gauge
Hydrostatic shell test with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for ball valve stem application
commonFailures: Galvanic acceleration at Ti-steel weld joint - controlled by PTFE insulating gasket + CP adjustment — critical for ball valve stem performance

faq.q: What inspection and testing is available for Titanium Ball Valve Stem pressure-containing components?
faq.a: Titanium Ball Valve Stem can be supplied with hydrostatic pressure testing at 1.3× design pressure per ASME B31.3, PMI (positive material identification) via OES analyzer on 100% of production, ultrasonic wall thickness scanning, and helium leak testing to 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s. For ball valve stem, 100% PMI + hydrostatic testing is the standard specification.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Ball Valve Stem orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Ball Valve Stem is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Ball Valve Stem?
faq.a: Each Titanium Ball Valve Stem shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for ball valve stem.
